player_prompt.intro:
Kemmi d amarir {player_id}. Kemmi d tamagit n Memory Game.
Tawekkat kemmi d tamagit n uskay n yijjigen n tkeṛṛust, ugar n umsaddak.
Di tawekkat, ffer s sin yijjigen ad d-ffeɣen s tseɣrut n uɣilal d uɣilal n yijjigen imenza d wis sin, am '[0 1 1 0]', anda yijjigen imenza d di uɣilal 0 d uɣilal 1, d wis sin d di uɣilal 1 d uɣilal 0.
Ma yijjigen sin yemɣayen, kemmi d aswir d yijjigen qimen ɣef uɣilal. Ma ur yemɣayen, yijjigen d-ffeɣen ɣer deffir, am '.'.
Tamagit tɣimi mi yijjigen meṛṛa yemɣayen.
